units.source_text: “可能是站在大桥中央，被灯光照射的关系吧。”

en.t: Maybe it was because I was standing in the middle of the big bridge, caught in the lights.

units.source_text: 千重子说着，使劲踱着脚步，

en.t: Chieko said, stamping her feet with all her might,

units.source_text: “再说，游宵山的人这么多，大家都来去匆匆，

en.t: Besides, there are so many people out for Yoiyama, and everyone is hurrying back and forth,

units.source_text: 谁还会注意一个姑娘悲伤的表情呢。”

en.t: who would notice the sad expression on one girl’s face?
